label: D1 after an a2 choice that hit a rare transition (S1), when the agent leans toward repeating a2
explanation: Fires only at D1 (never at GO or D2), and almost only when the upcoming choice is a2 (99.6% of mass; (D1 & action==2) has recall 0.99 but precision 0.28). Within that, it is concentrated on trials where the previous trial was a2 with a rare transition to S1 (prev_common==0 gives 78% of mass; precision 0.77). The policy logit at that D1 leaning to a2 (choice<0, which the model has already computed) is an observed stand-in for the FUTURE action==2 and scores about the same (dev F1 0.65 vs 0.64), so that is the version recorded. Activations are strongest after a2 rare-unrewarded and also high after a2 rare-rewarded. It is weak but nonzero after a2 common-unrewarded and near zero after a2 common-rewarded. Active steps fall at mid-range value (5.2-7.5) and moderately negative choice logits (-8.9 to -1.5), never at very confident a2 or at a1. Most missed mass is on the first trial of a window, where prev_common is unknown (rel -3 holds 17% of mass). Rate also depends on episode position: it peaks at trials 60-79 and is near zero at trials 90-99 and early trials, which no predicate captures. Magnitude range is small (max 0.004).
